Question 3

Express the Maclaurin series expansion for 11−x, given by 11−x=1+x+x2+x3+⋯,x∈(−1,1) using sigma notation.

a
 11−x=∑n=1∞x2nn!
b
 11−x=∑n=0∞xnn
c
 11+x=∑n=0∞x2n
d
 11−x=∑n=1∞(−1)nxn
e
 11−x=∑n=0∞xn
